shipped.note: Calculated from labeled scripted fixtures. Every offered pound counts once: collected_by_households_lb, else committed_to_food_banks_lb (committed to a food bank whose held storage and pickup hours let it hand the produce out before its usable time), else produce_wasted_lb (no pathway at the scenario end, including a commitment that spoils before it could be handed out). It is not observed spoilage. uncollected_by_scenario_households_lb is the earlier produce_wasted_lb: everything the scripted households did not collect. worst_served_coverage is the lowest food bank average of each chosen household's share of fair share received, zeros included. LLM not_run is not an LLM result.
